body.intent: Fix Plan runs fail at merge when main moves: the plan workflow's merge step ends the run with 'Not merged: origin/main has moved past PR's checked head; rebase and check again' (run 01M6MM3J, PR #272, 2026-11-05) instead of going back to rebase and wait for green as ship-change does, so any merge landing between rebased-green and merge strands a plan PR that then also conflicts on .rhiza/rendered. The merge step should loop back to rebase, within a cap.
